drafts.title: Brown Rice, Spinach and Chickpea Bowl
drafts.description: Original pending two-serving bowl draft. Measured rice is raw wholegrain brown rice, spinach is raw baby spinach, and chickpeas are canned, re-heated and drained. Method, timing, rights and allergy information await accountable review.
steps: Weigh 100g dry wholegrain brown rice and cook according to its packet directions.
Re-heat canned chickpeas according to their packet directions, then drain and weigh 300g of the re-heated drained chickpeas.
Wash and weigh 160g raw baby spinach. Divide the cooked rice, measured chickpeas and spinach between two bowls. Review the method and timing in a real cook-through before approval.
